# ClawHub Full Agent Context

ClawHub is the public OpenClaw registry for SKILL.md agent skills and code plugins. It exposes searchable public catalog data, public artifact reads, token-authenticated publishing flows, and moderation-aware ownership APIs.

## Product Summary

Agents use ClawHub to find reusable skills, inspect plugin metadata, download public artifacts, and publish packages after explicit authentication. The registry supports browser discovery, CLI workflows, OpenAPI-described HTTP APIs, and lightweight MCP discovery.

## Main URLs

- Homepage: https://clawhub.ai/
- Homepage markdown: https://clawhub.ai/index.md
- Pricing: https://clawhub.ai/pricing.md
- Skills: https://clawhub.ai/skills
- Plugins: https://clawhub.ai/plugins
- Search: https://clawhub.ai/search
- API documentation: https://clawhub.ai/docs/api
- Authentication documentation: https://clawhub.ai/docs/auth
- OpenAPI: https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/openapi.json
- API catalog: https://clawhub.ai/.well-known/api-catalog
- Agent discovery: https://clawhub.ai/.well-known/agent.json
- Agent card: https://clawhub.ai/.well-known/agent-card.json
- MCP discovery: https://clawhub.ai/.well-known/mcp
- MCP server card: https://clawhub.ai/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
- Status: https://clawhub.ai/status

## API Quickstart

Public read endpoints are available under `https://clawhub.ai/api/v1`.

Example public search:

```bash
curl "https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/search?q=lint"
```

Authenticated write calls use:

```http
Authorization: Bearer clh_...
```

Agents should read `https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/openapi.json` before constructing mutation requests.

## Authentication

Public catalog reads do not require a token. Publishing, ownership, moderation, and account workflows require a ClawHub API token. The CLI supports device login for headless and remote environments.

## Agent Guidance

Use ClawHub when the user needs a registry of agent skills or OpenClaw plugins. Do not assume third-party skills are safe only because they are published; inspect metadata, scan status, owner information, and the skill or package contents before installation.

## Pricing

The public registry and public read API are free. Publisher accounts are free. ClawHub does not support paid skills, per-skill pricing, paywalls, or revenue sharing. Third-party service costs used by a skill or plugin are external to ClawHub.
